    v3 = clamp(v2, min_val=1e-10, max_val=1e999)  # Tensor[(2, 2, 1), "f32"]; compute-cost flops=f32:4@logical,4@total,4@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r16/w16@total,r16/w16@cta; roofline ideal-ns=1 bound-by=balanced
    v0_2 = 448.0  # Tensor[(), "f32", "umat"]
    v4 = div(v3, v0_2)  # Tensor[(2, 2, 1), "f32"]; compute-cost flops=f32:4@logical,4@total,4@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r16/w16@total,r16/w16@cta;rmem:r4/w0@total,r4/w0@cta; roofline ideal-ns=1 bound-by=balanced
    v5 = div(v1, v4)  # Tensor[(2, 2, 128), "f32"]; compute-cost flops=f32:512@logical,512@total,512@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r2064/w2048@total,r2064/w2048@cta; roofline ideal-ns=1 bound-by=balanced
    v6 = clamp(v5, min_val=-448.0, max_val=448.0)  # Tensor[(2, 2, 128), "f32"]; compute-cost flops=f32:512@logical,512@total,512@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r2048/w2048@total,r2048/w2048@cta; roofline ideal-ns=1 bound-by=balanced
    v7 = cast(v6, dtype="fp8e4m3")  # Tensor[(2, 2, 128), "fp8e4m3"]; compute-cost flops=fp8e4m3:512@logical,512@total,512@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r2048/w512@total,r2048/w512@cta; roofline ideal-ns=1 bound-by=balanced
    v8 = reshape(v7, new_shape=(2, 256))  # Tensor[(2, 256), "fp8e4m3"]; compute-cost; traffic; roofline
    v9 = reshape(v4, new_shape=(2, 2))  # Tensor[(2, 2), "f32"]; compute-cost; traffic; roofline
    return (v8, v9)
